name: Blobbert and Tutorialbert
detailed_description:
Blobbert and Tutorialbert is a re-interpretation of the story of Blobbert's Bouncy Breakout, featuring Tutorialbert alongside Blobbert during the events of the game. Re-interpreted from an RPG into a 3D-Platformer and Beat-em-up hybrid, you will traverse through many different environments, with the ultimate goal of destroying Monoi... and maybe even another evil lurking in the shadows.

Venture through many environments based off the original ten from BBB. These include Monoi Laboratories, Dashington City, Spring Shores and its vast underwater infrastructure, an old western town made to emulate what was more than 50 years ago, Neo Neutropolis: The futuristic city in an alternate timeline and so many more!

Customize your primary character with new abilities until they're to your liking. Give Blobbert new things to do with his hammer, give Lydnia new moves and magic for her to be to your liking! Don't be restricted to the default moveset! Along with that, Tutorialbert is much stronger, but he has a set, yet powerful, moveset.

In this game, there are multiple campaigns. You can play the canon campaign, where Blobbert and Tutorialbert seek to take down Monoi. You can play a non-canon "what if" scenario where Lydnia and Tutorialbert team up, as Blobbert has gone bad. Or you can even play the bonus campaign featuring no new levels, but new dialogue, Although I'll let you find that one for yourselves.

Along with that, there are bonus levels where you can play as the villainous trio of the game: the slime squad! Play as Olivia in Alleyway Antics, Teresa in Dry Desert Dash and Mona in Rejuvenated Rooftops! Each of these characters have completely unique movesets compared to any other character in the game!

So what are you waiting for? Dive into the world of Blobbert and Tutorialbert and save it from destruction!

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600 or AMD Ryzen 5 1600X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750, 1 GB or Radeon RX 560, 4 GB
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
